description: This file defines the 'CoalescingFSEventsWatcher' class, which monitors file system events on specified paths using the FSEventStream API, providing coalesced notifications for rapid sequences of changes.

classes.name: CoalescingFSEventsWatcher
classes.description: A final class that sets up a file system event stream, handles event callbacks, and executes a coalesced change notification after a delay.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the watcher with paths, queue label, coalesce delay, notification filter, and change callback.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stops the watcher and releases resources upon deallocation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates and starts the FSEventStream to monitor the specified paths.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops and invalidates the current FSEventStream if active.

methods.name: handleEvents
methods.description: Processes incoming file system events, applies notification filtering, and schedules the coalesced onChange callback.
